errors.meaning: Input cannot be read or output cannot be written.
The dish cannot be coerced to the operation's input type.
An argument is missing, has the wrong type, is out of range or has an unknown name.
Input is malformed for a decoder, or cannot be represented by an encoder in strict mode.
A key or IV has the wrong length, or authentication failed.
The regex uses a construct outside the portable profile.
A regex call exceeded its timeout.
A size, depth or step limit was exceeded.
The recipe fails schema or semantic validation.
The operation id is unknown, including unmapped CyberChef operations on import.
scan --fail-on matched at least one finding.
Internal bug. The message asks the user to report it and includes version information.

warnings.meaning: A JSON object had a duplicate key; the last value was kept.
A jump reached its max count; execution continued past it.
A cryptographic choice is insecure (for example ECB mode or low PBKDF2 iterations).
